patch.summary: Salesforce cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Salesforce pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free Suite. 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Entry paid tier researched: Starter Suite

blocks.heading: Salesforce cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Salesforce against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free Suite until a gated capability (contact management (Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Enterprise, Unlimited)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite list price Enterprise list price Unlimited list price (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from list price Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Mid-market and enterprise sales orgs needing deep customization and reporting requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite list price Enterprise list price Unlimited list price (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from list price Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Premier Support is an add-on on Pro Suite. Agentforce for Sales, Sales Programs, Revenue Intelligence, and Revenue Cloud are separate paid add-ons; some require Contact us.

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Pro Suite, Enterprise, Unlimited, and Agentforce 1 Sales list prices are billed annually on the pricing page; only Starter Suite explicitly offers monthly or annual at the same list price USD list rate.

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not a lightweight SMB CRM — administration, implementation, and configuration overhead are part of the platform tradeoff versus Pipedrive-style tools.

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Steep learning curve and high administration/implementation overhead versus SMB CRMs

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Salesforce on identical constraints.
